title: MixDQ: Memory-Efficient Few-Step Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Metric-Decoupled Mixed Precision Quantization
tldr_zh: 少步扩散量化瓶颈在文本嵌入BOS离群值；BOS跳过+指标解耦+整数规划配比特，W4A8仅+0.5 FID
tldr_en: Few-step diffusion quantization bottlenecked by BOS outliers; BOS-skip + metric-decoupled sensitivity + integer programming achieves W4A8 with +0.5 FID
